shortDescription: 8-week four-day upper and lower hypertrophy split with extra volume and progression room.
descriptionHtml:
8-week four-day upper and lower hypertrophy split with extra volume and progression room.

Structure: 8 weeks, 4 scheduled sessions per week, 26 referenced exercise ids.

Weekly split: Upper #1, Lower #1, Upper #2, and Lower #2.

  • Goal: hypertrophy
  • Level: intermediate
  • Duration: 8 weeks
  • Tags: upper lower and 4 days per week
